subject.title: fix(google): use stable Gemini image model

question: Should this PR own the OpenRouter stable Gemini Images API routing now, or should it narrow to Google and doctor migration while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97505 owns OpenRouter routing?
rationale: The Google/doctor migration repair is mechanical, but the OpenRouter fix overlaps a broader open PR and affects provider endpoint routing, model choice, and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Narrow OpenRouter Here
options.body: Keep this PR focused on Google defaults and doctor migrations, preserving Pro, and let the dedicated OpenRouter Images PR own stable OpenRouter endpoint routing.

options.title: Adopt Images Routing
options.body: Expand this PR to route stable OpenRouter image IDs through /images with response parsing and model-specific caps before merge.

options.title: Pause For Provider Policy
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers choose one canonical OpenRouter image-model policy and rebase the losing branch away.

recommendation.title: Narrow OpenRouter Here
recommendation.body: Keep this PR focused on Google defaults and doctor migrations, preserving Pro, and let the dedicated OpenRouter Images PR own stable OpenRouter endpoint routing.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on image provider defaults and OpenRouter routing, where git history shows recent area ownership.
